brief: Draws a grid of square cells with box lines, marking the current cell, obstacles and a path, for navigation and puzzles.
detail: A stzTile is a stzGrid, so build one with new stzTile([ columns, rows ]) or StzTileQ(...) and use every grid method: AddObstacle, MoveToNode, paths, connected regions (Rooms). The class adds the drawing: Show prints it, ToString returns it, Legend names the characters used, and ShowCustomGrid draws other contents in the same frame. Positions count from 1, with the column first.
